title: Exercise
description: Catalog entry: a single exercise with localized text and free-use media.

variant_of.description: Movement family. Exercises sharing it are interchangeable variations (e.g. hip_thrust: barbell, Smith, machine).

movement_pattern.description: Training pattern (squat, hinge, hip_thrust, lunge, row, ...). Used to cover required patterns and avoid duplicates.

compound.description: True for multi-joint exercises, which are ordered before isolation work.

required_equipment.description: Equipment keys the exercise needs (e.g. barbell+bench, dumbbell, machine, smith). 'none' = bodyweight.
